description: Four core test-force endpoints used by the main-text accuracy-cost synthesis; 3BPA is retained as an appendix temperature-transfer study.
selection_rule: one checkpoint per model selected on validation Force MAE; test never selects

aggregation.endpoint_weighting: equal weight across four core test endpoints
aggregation.normalization: divide each model Force MAE by the lowest observed Force MAE on that endpoint
aggregation.summary: geometric mean of four normalized Force MAEs
